notes.text: For V2EX topic edit/create flow, always ensure both #topic_title and #topic_content are populated before clicking save. Editing only the title can leave the post body empty or unchanged.
The real persisted body field is #topic_content. On edit/review flows, verify its value length with javascript_eval before saving if there is any doubt.
When posting DOMPrompter-like developer tools, the 程序员 node can carry a soft developer-workflow angle focused on interface micro-tuning rather than hard product promotion.

workflows.name: Create or edit a V2EX topic
steps: Open /new or the topic edit page
Confirm the target node if creating a new post
Fill #topic_title with a problem-led title that includes the product name
Fill #topic_content with the full body before saving
Click the submit button and wait for navigation to the final topic URL
Verify the final page title and confirm GitHub/product links appear in the body
